noun_definition: Tag refers to a label used in the workspace settings to categorize items, which can have dependent subtags associated with them in the context of managing GL codes.
gl code refers to a specific identifier that is intended to be saved for a tag or subtag within the workspace settings in the context of the issue.
Dependant tag refers to a tag that is associated with a subtag in the workspace settings, which is expected to retain a General Ledger (GL) code when saved.
